title: Homelab / Overview
description: One page for 'is anything wrong right now': alerts, nodes, workloads, GPU, service checks, logs. Click a stat to open the dashboard or tool with the detail.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Prometheus alerts firing now (Watchdog excluded). Details in the table below.

panels.title: Containers stuck
panels.description: Containers waiting in CrashLoopBackOff, image pull or config errors.

panels.title: Pods pending
panels.description: Pods that can't be scheduled or are still pulling. Usually a node out of memory or a PVC that won't attach.

panels.title: Scrape targets down
panels.description: Prometheus targets failing their scrape. A non-zero count is what TargetDown alerts on; see Prometheus > Targets for which.

panels.title: Argo apps not healthy
panels.description: Needs the ArgoCD ServiceMonitor added in this change.

panels.title: Slack alerts failed (24h)
panels.description: Alertmanager notifications to Slack that failed in the last day. Non-zero means alerts are firing but nobody hears about them.

panels.title: Soonest cert expiry
panels.description: Days until the next cert-manager certificate expires. cert-manager renews at 30 days, so under 30 means a renewal is failing.

panels.title: Fullest PVC
panels.description: Most-used persistent volume. See Homelab / Storage for which one.

panels.title: Fullest Proxmox storage
panels.description: Most-used Proxmox storage pool (local-lvm thin pools, PBS, NFS). A full thin pool corrupts guest disks. See Homelab / Proxmox.

panels.title: etcd WAL fsync p99
panels.description: Healthy is under 10 ms. See Homelab / Control plane.

panels.title: GPU utilization
panels.description: RTX 2070S on k8s-n2, from the GPU operator's DCGM exporter.

panels.title: Error log lines (15m)
panels.description: Lines that look like errors across all pods. Breakdown in Homelab / Logs.

targets.expr: max by (alertname, severity, namespace, pod) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor"})
(1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m]))) * 100 * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info)
(1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes) * 100 * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info)

panels.title: Monitors not up
panels.description: Uptime Kuma monitors that are down, pending or in maintenance. Kuma alerts Slack itself; this is the at-a-glance count.

panels.title: Monitors not up
panels.description: Empty when every monitor is up.

panels.title: Lowest uptime, last 24h (bottom 10)
panels.description: Kuma's own 1-day uptime ratio per monitor.

panels.title: Response time (slowest 8)
panels.description: As measured by Kuma from inside the cluster.

panels.title: Certificate days left (soonest 10)
panels.description: TLS expiry as seen by Kuma, including hosts cert-manager doesn't manage (Proxmox, PBS, the NAS).
